thread:
Tori Nguyen: hi folks, first oncall rotation this week. two blockers: can't clone runbooks (403) and my PagerDuty tests show delivered but no SMS. any quick tips? :wave:
Ben Hall: welcome! for the repo 403 usually means missing git team membership or Okta SSO expired. which auth method?
Tori Nguyen: https w/ company SSO. git error: 'the requested URL returned error: 403'
Marisol Vega: added you to git-runbooks team and pushed a permission sync. try `git clone https://git.redwood.com/runbooks.git` again.
DevOps Bot: permission sync complete for tori.nguyen@redwood.com — repo read granted.
Tori Nguyen: clone succeeded, thanks. about SMS, PagerDuty delivery log shows delivered but carrier blocked. is email fallback sufficient for ack?
Ben Hall: email works but slower. Enable mobile push + add a backup contact method (work phone). Also in iOS enable Critical Alerts for PagerDuty and toggle "Override Do Not Disturb" in PD settings.
Marisol Vega: for the first live shift we'll pair you with a senior. Quick triage checklist: 1) Acknowledge in PD, 2) run `runbook lookup <service>` and paste a 1-line status to #incidents, 3) if no progress in 15m escalate to L2 via our `esc` tool, 4) call the incident commander for customer-impacting SEV1s.
Tori Nguyen: great, where's the escalation matrix?
Ben Hall: runbooks/docs/escalation-matrix.md or Confluence -> Oncall Playbook. Also complete the "Oncall Shadow Lab" before your first live rotation to get full escalation rights.
Tori Nguyen: got it — joining the shadow lab tonight. thanks for the quick help :pray:
DevOps Bot: Reminder: Complete "Oncall Shadow Lab" and "Incident Comms" micro-course by Friday to unlock full rotation privileges.
